reviews.text:
★☆☆☆☆


I was charged three separate times for a subscription that was advertised as a single payment. After discovering the unauthorized multiple charges, I contacted customer support twice and provided all the necessary transaction records. Despite this, I have received no meaningful response regarding the remaining refunds.

Only one charge was refunded, while the other payments are still missing. What is even more disappointing is the complete lack of communication and accountability from the support team. Customers should not have to chase a company for weeks just to recover money that was incorrectly charged.

A billing system that charges customers multiple times and a customer service team that ignores refund requests is simply unacceptable. Until this issue is fully resolved and customer support improves significantly, I cannot recommend this app to anyone.

Very disappointing experience.

reviews.title: Misleading Subscription Design Resulting in Unauthorized Charge
reviews.text:
I purchased a subscription while setting up my account. During the setup process, I was shown information about an infographic and prompted to tap a Continue button. I did not intend to purchase a subscription; however, after tapping Continue, I was charged $19.99 through my Apple account.

I immediately requested to cancel the subscription and receive a refund. However, Ashley from customer support informed me that my subscription was already canceled and that I could continue using it until February. This response does not address my refund request.

The way the subscription flow is designed is misleading. After the initial subscription, no purchase confirmation is required, and tapping Continue—which does not clearly indicate a paid action—results in a charge. This creates confusion and leads users to unintentionally purchase a subscription.

If I do not receive a refund within two days, I will proceed with contacting my bank to dispute the charge.

reviews.title: Liberal-leaning recommendations

I attempted to adjust the preferences to remove these selections, and was disappointed they continued to appear in my daily suggestions. To test my theory, I searched for conservative leaning material to discover none were available or included, either by title or theme. I hoped for a neutral array of book summaries but found a selection meant to indoctrinate not inform. If this is what you’re seeking, you’ve found it. Otherwise I recommend another micro-learning app.

reviews.title: I want a refund. Clunky app and custom service
reviews.text:
The app/service accepted my yearly premium payment and functioned for maybe a week. After that it’s been a nightmare and still a nightmare! Every morning I am denied access or none of the books will load. I have been reaching out to customer support and it seems like all I’m getting is an automated response loop. 

If the app denies access, I would reset my password. Then I’m allowed in my account via app where I would need to restore my purchase. After that none of the books will load and play. Go to manage subscription and it routes me to the website where every time I try to login I am given an error message. 

Emailed customer support and at first I’m told to reset my password which I’ve already done. Then at 1:30am I receive another email from a different product support personnel telling me that they have no record of me purchasing their subscription and requested my userID, date of purchase, exact amount, last four digits of the card I used. 

I provided them screenshots of the receipt email from time of purchase, a screenshot of my banking records, and a copy of my userID. I am here now because I have no other option. I’m frustrated and tired of wasting my time, energy, and money. I want a full refund and if I’m not given my full refund, then I will file fraud charges on apple App Store and with my financial institution.

reviews.title: Better than Instagram??
reviews.text:
OK, I was on Instagram when I saw this ad and said that it can make you more intelligent. But when I downloaded it, it takes you to a paywall that you can bypass. Features that you can’t use without a paywall. Rewards that you can’t have unless you pay. I don’t know how I’m supposed to feel more intelligent. But it seems that wiser thinks that being smart is spending money. 

Instagram never charged me like this. And regardless, how people look at endless scrolling. There are some channels that can make you smart. 

This app doesn’t do that. It gives you pat on the back and says you’re smart for giving us your money.
